result.title: To Keep or Not to Keep: Learning KV Cache Retention in Disaggregated LLM Serving Systems
result.summary: Disaggregated \textsc{LLM} serving separates prefill and decode across node pools, placing a network fabric between \textsc{KV}-cache computation and consumption. This breaks a key assumption of classical cache policies: a miss no longer incurs only local recomputation, but also network transfer to the decode node. Likewise, admitting a block to the global cache requires an additional transfer, so poor retention decisions waste both memory and bandwidth. We present \textbf{KVLearn}, a learning-based framework for cost-aware \textsc{KV}-cache retention in disaggregated serving. KVLearn includes: (i) a lightweight Prefix Reuse Predictor (\textsc{PRP}) that estimates reuse probability from structural and temporal prefix features without modifying model weights; (ii) a Cost-Aware Retention Score (\textsc{CARS}) that converts reuse probability into keep/admit decisions using recomputation, transfer, and storage costs; and (iii) an Adaptive Threshold Controller (\textsc{ATC}) that adjusts admission thresholds online from observed hit rates and memory pressure. We integrate KVLearn into a globally disaggregated serving topology and evaluate it on text and multimodal workloads, including large image/video-derived \textsc{KV} blocks with heterogeneous reuse patterns. KVLearn reduces end-to-end time-to-first-token by up to 56% versus No-Cache, 38% versus LRU-Pool, and 33% versus Mooncake-style baselines, while cutting inter-node \textsc{KV} transfer volume by up to 53% versus LRU-Pool. On MM-Session, throughput remains within ${\sim}5%$ of oracle. Code is available at https://github.com/FastLM/KVLearn.

AI.brief_summary: 针对分离式 LLM 服务中 KV 缓存未命中既需重算又需跨节点传输的问题，提出 KVLearn：用轻量前缀复用预测器估计复用概率，再折算重算、传输与存储成本形成保留/准入评分，并用在线阈值控制器调节准入策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「学习预测复用概率＋成本加权保留决策＋在线阈值」可作核查线索，可能迁移到 latent 状态与视觉证据的缓存取舍及 THINK/LOOK/STOP 成本核算，但原论文关注服务层 KV 缓存，与推理期内部状态的关系尚未验证。
